Today, January 9, 2026,
I went to pick up my cat, whom I had boarded since December 20, 2025. He was in the bed we had left for him, surrounded by feces and urine with a very strong odor. The spa cleaning staff attended to me for checkout and acknowledged that the person(s) responsible for the animals had not acted properly regarding their care and hygiene. I spoke personally with Asier, who indicated he is the assistant manager, to report the incident and request that corrective measures be taken with those responsible for the care and attention of pets at Devesa Gardens. It is unacceptable that they failed to provide a better impression upon the animal's return, which is clearly a serious breach of duty. Customer number 102086.
My dog ​​Piluca was great, I had to leave her for a day, and I'll do it again, great service
My friend left her dog and took him to the vet when she came out. He had been abused. I hope no one ever does that to anyone.
